section_01.text_006: Keeping website decisions and business assets connected.
section_01.text_007: My contribution: project management & communications at Tony & Co. Brand, design, motion, video and development were delivered collaboratively by the project team.

section_02.text_009: A brand and website engagement can expand into templates, presentations and other business assets. Feedback has to remain connected to the correct page, file and workstream.
section_02.text_011: I coordinate client reviews, consolidate website feedback, maintain the asset checklist and prepare the development handover.
section_02.text_012: Tracked feedback across homepage, service pages and related website content.
section_02.text_013: Organized the asset inventory into reviewable deliverables and shared current links.
section_02.text_014: Connected client updates, team priorities and handover preparation across the workstreams.
section_02.text_016: A maintained asset checklist, linked review files and a coordinated feedback workflow. The engagement is still in progress.
section_02.text_017: What this means for your team
section_02.text_018: A shared inventory turns a broad request into work that can be assigned, reviewed and handed over.
section_02.text_020: Need someone to connect the moving parts?
